moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-blur-crossfade, written here): Two words stacked in the same spot. Swap: old opacity 1 → 0 and blur 0 → 10 px while new opacity 0 → 1 and blur 10 → 0 px, together, 0.6 s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) (recipe range 0.4–0.7 s). Demo: A → B 0.8–1.4 s, back 2.6–3.2 s; new word in accent; loop 3.6 s. Params: to: từ mới · duration (0.6 s) · blur (10 px) · ease (cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)).
